q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of duplex board per tonne?
title: Duplex board carbon per tonne
short: Add the boiler fuel at its default factor and mill electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, divide by tonnes of board, then add the waste paper, coating clay and binders from supplier data. The coating line adds drying energy, so coated grades use more than uncoated ones.
audience: Board mills, carton makers and FMCG packaging buyers

ul: Steam for drying the board and the coating.
Electricity for pulping, refining and the board machine.

p: Report each grade separately if the mill makes both, since coating and its drying change the energy per tonne.
FMCG brands ask carton makers for board figures. Give the mill figure per tonne with its boundary, so the carton maker can add printing and conversion.

example.title: Worked example: mill energy per tonne (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Boiler PNG: 160,000 scm x 2.05 = 328,000 kg CO2
Total: 754,000 kg CO2 for 900 t of duplex board = 837.8 kg CO2 per tonne
Add waste paper, coating clay and binders from supplier data
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your boiler and mill records.
